notes:
The list runs from p. 101 (n112.jpg) to p. 102 (n113.jpg). It has 44 stations, numbered 119 to 162 on the map with no gaps, and 25 of them have an asterisk. Both figures match the lead-in: "forty-four lighthouses and light-vessels ... twenty-five of them returns". The other images are text pages: n110 is p. 99 (West Coast of Scotland); I did not open n111 or n114. There are four columns: an asterisk with the map number, the type in small capitals (written here as L.H./L.V.), the station name, and the keeper(s). The list gives no light characters, places, other figures or sub-headings, so every row is under the section heading "WEST COAST OF ENGLAND AND WALES."

How I transcribed it:
- Dot leaders link a name to its keeper. In "printed" I have shortened every run of leaders to "........." because their length varies.
- Stations without a keeper are printed with a full stop after the name ("Air.", "Lundy."). That full stop is kept in "name".
- "Start Point." is printed with a full stop and then leaders, so it is kept as "Start Point.".
- Each keepers string keeps its final full stop.
- Nothing in the list is in italics.

Unclear print:
- The asterisks on 131 (Bardsey Island) and 133 (South Bishop) print as solid dots (•). They must be asterisks for the total to reach 25, so I recorded them as *.
- Several other asterisks (128, 129, 130, 136, 142, 160) are lighter and differently shaped, but they are clearly asterisks.
- The "1" of 146 is damaged and looks like "J".

Names to check against other years and sources (copied as printed, not corrected):
- "S. Woek" (Dee L.V.): the OCR also reads Woek. It may be a misprint, e.g. for Wook or Work.
- "John W. Froth" (Bishop's Rock).
- "— Cumming": printed with a dash in place of the first name or initial.
- "Air" is the Point of Air lighthouse.
- These spellings are period forms or the printer's: "Caldy" (Caldey), "Sevenstones" (Seven Stones), "Bishop's Rock" (Bishop Rock), "Carnarvon Bay", "Flatholm", "Nash (E.)" (East Nash), "Smalls" (no "The").
- "Usk", "Avon" and "Burnham" are listed as L.H.
- Some keepers' names are abbreviated: "Wm. Davies", "J. W. Watson".
- Two stations have joint entries, each kept as a single entry: Selker (D. Kneale and — Cumming), Dee (S. Woek and J. Clague) and Longships (J. W. Watson and Wm. Davies).

In the OCR, "#119", "7a28", "*1630", "A00", "*467" and "£160" are all misreadings of the asterisked numbers 119, 128, 152, 153, 157 and 160.
